title: Merle Ambrose offers a new wizard WC-MAIN-C01-001 in his house: its Prep lines with his portrait, then the offer window, and ACCEPT on the last line takes it
notes: 7.09: Merle Ambrose, template 38168 (WC-HUB-NPC01), is the first actor of the Prep dialog of WC-MAIN-C01-001, the enrollment quest authored in
data/sql/updates/db_world/2026_10_13_00.sql, so a wizard that does not hold it is offered it as a Prep option when it walks up to him.
Taking the option sends MSG_INTERACTNPC for QuestOfferService, and the server sends MSG_ACTORDIALOG with the Prep lines and MSG_QUESTOFFER with the title,
the Talk To goal and its location. The last line's right button is ACCEPT, which sends MSG_ACCEPTQUEST; a mainline quest shows no DECLINE.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
